content.question: What is normalization in neural networks?
options: A technique that increases the number of trainable parameters in each layer.
A set of techniques that adjust the distribution of inputs or hidden activations to a common scale.
A method for reducing the size of the training dataset by removing outliers.
A way to convert all model outputs into binary values.
content.answer: A set of techniques that adjust the distribution of inputs or hidden activations to a common scale.
